Final green head (2026-11-26T19:56Z): `3ce748c6e790e53b120bcc3f919b9839aa3d5ab4`. Per the card thread, every check passed or was skipped by its filter. That includes Live E2E UI, Build & E2E UI, all 16 Test UI shards, Type Check UI, Lint UI, the gate families and Check Changeset, and a merge test against origin/main is clean. The area PATCHed the body with the card thread's text plus the late additions. Sent to seat `repo:objectstack#5` for L1.

Area notes for L1:
1. **Two halves, one card.** Half 1 adds the top-left rows, the switcher, the rail and the title-row fallback, each in its own file. Half 2 comes after #37546 and deletes the top bar, moving each of its tenants to the home ADR-0084 gives it.
2. **A gap in ADR-0084's homes table (area call, option A).** The `~org` scope has no 概览, so deleting the bar would have left no way to publish its drafts. `StudioScopePendingRow` opens the existing sheet and `doPublish`. It is pinned, with an ablation. It is flagged in Acceptance for the contract review. If the seat wants the ADR to record it, the area files a separate docs/adr follow-up.
3. **Maintainer-asked rename.** The switcher names `~org` 「组织元数据」 / "Organization metadata", via the new key `engine.studio.pkg.orgScope`. The menu row keeps 「组织级流程」.
4. **Main merged three times**, each one forced by a conflict. Main's incoming test assertions are kept wherever they still hold without the bar. The dropped bar-only assertions are listed in Acceptance.
5. **Re-pointed, not loosened:** `e2e/studio-left-menu-36899` (the rail) and `e2e/live/studio-customize-journey` (publish from 概览 Pending, which still asserts the publish-drafts POST), plus the unit suites listed in Tests. **Deleted tests** are listed with the reason each one's claim is gone or held elsewhere.
6. **Follow-up:** #37580 (ResourceListPage New on a read-only package).
7. **Screenshots:** `objectstack-seat5/topic-37424/cards/shots-37456/final/`, in light and dark: no bar, the switcher, the rail, 概览 Pending, ~org Changes, the ~org name, and the phone strip and drawer.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `3ce748c6e790e53b120bcc3f919b9839aa3d5ab4`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #37456 (body and its 3 comments: triage, the area's scope note 7189582815, the claim 7192639020), PR #37579 (body, 44-file list, net diff `origin/main...pr-37579-a`, read source first and then tests), and the check-runs on the head. Every gate-carrying run is `success`: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI (16/16), Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Changeset, PR-body guards and Check PR Size. Build Core is `skipped` because the diff is UI only.

### ① Derived judgments

- **`@object-ui/app-shell`: no public-surface change. Right.** The package is `"private": true`, its `exports` map is `"."` alone, and `src/index.ts` re-exports only `StudioDesignSurface` from this tree, whose props (`aiSlot`, `area`) are unchanged. The removed `StudioBackToApp`, `STUDIO_HEADER`, `STUDIO_HEADER_PACKAGE_COLUMN` and `STUDIO_HEADER_WIDE_WORD` are module-internal. The new `StudioTopLeft`, `StudioPackageSwitcher`, `StudioTitleRowFallback`, `StudioBackButton` and the `head` prop on `StudioMenu` are module-internal too.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: five keys added, none removed or renamed. Right, but see N1 on how the PR declares it.** The new keys are `engine.studio.pkg.switcher`, `.search`, `.noMatches`, `.newPackage` and `.orgScope`, in both en and zh.
- **No accept-set change.** There is no server, route, spec or protocol code in the diff. Publish still goes through the same `doPublish` and `POST /api/v1/packages/ID/publish-drafts`, and package creation still uses the existing `CreatePackageDialog`.
- **Behaviour.** The top bar is gone. Its tenants now live in the left column's two rows, on 概览 (#37454) and in the title row (#37455). The Create app button is retired per ADR-0084 `#amendment-2026-11-26-silent` item 5. The rail is `collapsible="icon"`. The phone strip below 768 px follows silent item 4. A switcher pick lands on 概览 (`studioPackageOverviewPath`), per silent item 3. Kernel packages are left out of the list and pairs are folded. `beforeNavigate` runs before every departure, including after a create. These match the amendment, with the exceptions in the findings.

**Findings**

- S1 (should-fix) — Two user-facing strings now point at controls this PR deletes:
  - `engine.studio.newApp.appFailed` (en and zh) tells the author to "Use Create app in the Studio top bar to try again". It is read by `PackageFormDialog.tsx:675`, the dialog that this PR's own New package door opens.
  - `engine.studio.data.draftObjectHint` (en and zh, read by `DataPillar.tsx:2289`) says to click "Publish" in the top bar.

  Point them at the 应用 row and at 概览 › Pending. Separately, the "Save in the top bar" strings were already stale since #37455: the permission-set notes, `engine.studio.customize.saveFooter` and `engine.studio.inspector.draftFooter`. Note them or file a follow-up.
- S2 (should-fix) — The way back is lost on the package-not-found page. `showMenu = !pkgMissing` hides the left column there, so with no top bar that page draws no `StudioBackButton`. On main, the bar's 「‹ Back to app」 was drawn on it. The page keeps its own exit (Setup › Packages, or the package-less scope), so no one is stranded. Still, a former tenant is gone on one page: the PR body does not name it, and `notFound-26708` now pins its absence. The card's acceptance says no top-bar feature is lost. Either draw the way back there, or name the loss and get it ruled.
- S3 (should-fix) — The `~org` "Changes · N" row (`StudioScopePendingRow`) is a home that ADR-0084's homes table does not have. The PR body says the table "should gain this row in a later amendment" but names no card. File the docs/adr follow-up and cite it on the PR (Prime Directives 10 and 13). Seat question 3 has the details.
- N1 (nit) — `Clause-②: no` while the published `@object-ui/i18n` gains five catalog keys. The package's CHANGELOG precedent is split: some entries declare new keys as `yes (widening)`, others ship `no`. The level is `patch` either way.
- N2 (nit) — The 「组织元数据」 rename rests on a maintainer request "in the card thread" that does not appear on GitHub card #37456 (its three comments are bot records). Put a pointer to the request on the card.
- N3 (nit) — Dead code and stale prose are left behind:
  - `DraftChangesPanel`'s `confirm` posture no longer has a caller.
  - Unreferenced keys: `engine.studio.app.*`, `publish`, `publishTitle`, `backToApp` and `engine.studio.org.name`. The body names most of these.
  - Doc comments still describe the top bar's Publish or Create app: `StudioPackageOverviewPage.tsx:22`, `StudioPackageMenu.tsx:29`, `newAppDoor.ts:17`, `StudioPermissionSetPage.tsx:86`.
- N4 (nit) — `StudioTopLeft` swaps trees between the two rows and the rail head. Each collapse or expand therefore remounts `StudioPackageSwitcher`, which sends a fresh `GET /api/v1/packages`. Request coalescing only joins reads that are already on the wire.
- N5 (nit) — The claim of `publishReadOnlyReason-12303` was that the reason reaches the keyboard and assistive tech. It has no successor. The new lock is a non-focusable `role="img"` whose reason is in `title` only, and a read-only Pending tab drops Publish without saying why inline.

### ② Semver level

`patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell` (private, so nothing reaches npm) and on `@object-ui/i18n` (additive keys). This matches what the diff publishes. Both declaration lines are in the PR body and in the changeset (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), and Check Changeset is green. Clause-② is judged `no` as declared: nothing is narrowed, and the only arguable widening is the i18n keys (N1). It is not a narrowing, so this is not the narrowing face. `Metadata-protocol: none` is right because nothing an author writes changes.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flags.**
  - The `~org` gap (S3).
  - The leftover i18n keys (N3): accepted as a later sweep.
  - Follow-up #37580: the card's "tooltip on New" is deferred to the list page. #37580 is filed and open, so the deferral is accepted.
  - The three main merges: incoming assertions are kept wherever they still hold, and the two `studio-shell-header` anchors are re-pointed. Accepted.
  - The e2e re-points (`studio-left-menu-36899`, `live/studio-customize-journey`) are re-pointed, not loosened. Live E2E UI and Build & E2E UI are green.
- **Card scope note 7189582815.** A page with no title row keeps its panel control: `StudioTitleRowFallback`, pinned in `StudioTopLeft-37456`. Held.
- **`open_questions`.** None declared.
- **SQL push-down.** There is no server or query code. The switcher joins served apps to packages by `_packageId` and drops kernel rows, all in the client, over lists it already reads. It materialises no new ids against a store. No finding.
- **Landing.** `additions + deletions` = 3,179, which is above 3,000. Per AGENTS.md (multi-agent discipline item 7(c)), this PR lands only after an authorized APPROVED review, or by the maintainer's merge or enqueue. Green checks alone do not land it. The diff has no governed path.
- **Security.** No security defect found.

Security-touching: no

### Seat questions

**1. Deleted tests.**
- `narrowHeader-12509` pinned the bar's 48 px two-column layout. That is retired by the frame (no top bar).
- `createAppAccessibleName`, the app case of `CreateItemDialog.labels-13128` and the app block of `createTaken-26917` pinned Create app. It is retired by silent item 5. The dialog's label binding stays pinned by the object case in `CreateItemDialog.labels-13128`. The taken-app refusal lives on in the New package app step, pinned in `PackageFormDialog.newAppStep-36748` ("an app name already taken refuses the confirm").
- `publishPosture-12517`: the confirm posture's only door was the bar's Publish, which is retired. "Nothing pending, no door" is re-pinned by the 概览 badge's absence in `copilotDraftBadge-12725` and `metadataArea-28561`.
- `publishReadOnlyReason-12303`: "read-only, no Publish" is re-pinned in `noTopBar-37456`. The part about the reason reaching the keyboard and assistive tech is lost (N5).
- `changesCount-11787`: its surface half (at least one from the render the save lands in) is held by `metadataArea-28561`. Its own-read, stale-answer-ignored half is held by `preview/usePendingDrafts.afterSave-11787.test.tsx`, which the PR body does not name.

One case was dropped silently: "on a narrow bar the app name gives way" inside `backToApp-36501`. It is retired with the bar, and the switcher's name truncation is unpinned (nit level). The way back on the not-found page is also lost silently (S2).

**2. Former top-bar tenants.**
- **Changes:** the 概览 badge (`studio-menu-overview-pending`) opens Pending. On `~org` it is the `studio-scope-changes` row. `?changes=review` still opens the sheet.
- **Publish:** 概览 › Pending's embedded panel (#37454). On `~org`, the sheet's Publish.
- **Copilot doors:** the applied card's `?changes=review` link and the badge counts (`copilotDoors-12894`, `copilotDraftBadge-12725`).
- **Access segment:** retired as a bar segment by #36899. The Access menu group, re-anchored in `accessSegment-12452`.
- **Desktop hint:** under the phone strip (`desktopHint-11795`).
- **Save bar:** the item header (#37455, `saveBar-36511`).
- **Right slot and assistant:** the end of the title row (#37455, `rightSlot-12725`). On a page with no title row, `StudioTitleRowFallback`.
- **Back-to-app:** `StudioBackButton`, first in the package row and in the rail. Lost on the not-found page (S2).
- **Menu toggle:** Studio's row, and the phone strip.
- **⋯ menu:** 概览's header.
- **Create app:** retired by ADR-0084 silent item 5.

**3. The `~org` scope.** The row is coherent with ADR-0084. It does not reverse a decision. It fills a hole the amendment leaves: the homes table sends Changes and Publish to 概览, and silent item 1 gives `~org` no 概览. Without the row, `~org` drafts would have no way to publish, and the card's "nothing lost" rule would break. It reuses the existing sheet and `doPublish`, and it lives and dies with the `~org` entry (`#amendment-2026-11-26-org`). It is not a must-fix. The ADR row should be filed as a docs/adr follow-up card (S3). Amending the ADR in this PR would add a Tier H path for no gain.

**4. The rename.** Present in both locales: `engine.studio.pkg.orgScope` is "Organization metadata" in en and 「组织元数据」 in zh. It is read by `StudioPackageSwitcher.tsx:171` for the `~org` trigger and pinned in `StudioTopLeft-37456`. The menu row keeps `engine.studio.menu.orgFlows` (「组织级流程」, "Organization flows"). Nothing else now shows the old name as the scope's name: the bar's back-name slot that used `orgFlows` for `~org` is deleted. `engine.studio.org.name` (「组织流程」) is unreferenced (N3). The request itself has no GitHub record (N2).

**5. The changeset.** The deletions are internal. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `"private": true` and exports only `"."`. Its barrel re-exports `StudioDesignSurface` from this tree, with unchanged props. `StudioBackToApp`, the `STUDIO_HEADER*` tokens and the Create app state and dialog were never on a published surface. `@object-ui/i18n` only gains keys. No published export or prop is removed, so this is not a narrowing. `patch` and `Clause-②: no` hold (with N1 on the widening reading).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-vyx9gu`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CYtTDvfPQDzMbZnN5X`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对

Head-sha: `3ce748c6e790e53b120bcc3f919b9839aa3d5ab4`
**REWORK** — L1, seat repo:objectstack#5

1. **Shape**: draft against `main`, UI only, 44 files, +1570/−1609. Not governed by path, but at 3179 changed lines it is over the 3000 human-merge line. The maintainer has already approved landing once review passes, and os-zhuang APPROVED at this head. Not security-touching. `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch on `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`: right. The deletions are internal to a private package.
2. **Premise**: every former top-bar tenant has a named home or a retiring card (record 7202356468, seat question 2). The `~org` "Changes · N" row fills a gap in ADR-0084 without reversing a decision. The 「组织元数据」 rename is in en and zh.
3. **Gates**: contract record 7202356468 (`TIER_DEFAULT`, declaration face) reads **PASS**, but S1–S3 are open. CI on this head: all gate-carrying runs green.
4. **Owed before landing**:
   - **S1**: `engine.studio.newApp.appFailed` and `engine.studio.data.draftObjectHint` (en + zh) still tell the user to use controls this PR deletes ("Create app in the Studio top bar", "Publish" in the top bar). Repoint them to the 应用 row and 概览 › Pending. In the same push, fix the stale "Save in the top bar" strings left since #37455, or name them in a follow-up card.
   - **S2**: the package-not-found page has no way back now that the bar is gone (`showMenu = !pkgMissing` hides the column, and `notFound-26708` pins the absence). Either restore `StudioBackButton` on that page, with the pin flipped, or say in the body why it is dropped, and file a card for it. The card's acceptance says no top-bar feature is lost.
   - **S3**: file the docs/adr follow-up for ADR-0084's homes table (the `~org` Changes row), and cite its number in the PR body in place of "a later amendment".
   - N1–N5 are accepted as deviations or follow-up cards at the area's choice: N1 is the `Clause-②` widening reading of the new i18n keys, N2 is the rename's provenance, N3 is the leftovers, N4 is the switcher remount, and N5 is the read-only reason for keyboard and assistive-tech users. A card for N5 is recommended.
5. **Next**: push one fix commit, then knock. The same reviewer reads the delta alone. On PASS the seat ACCEPTs and the area lands it with `--land`, citing the maintainer's approval. If the push dismisses os-zhuang's review, he must approve again.
